title: Concept Mapping Review
description:
The Concept Mapping Review queue is where data stewards review AI-suggested mappings from source codes to OMOP standard concepts. Harmonia generates and re-ranks candidate mappings; reviewers approve, reject, or escalate each suggestion.

Filter by status (pending, approved, rejected, escalated) and confidence, sort the queue to triage low-confidence or frequently-seen codes first, and use keyboard shortcuts to move through the queue rapidly.
tips: Sort by 'Lowest confidence first' to focus review effort where the model is least certain.
Sort by 'Most seen first' to prioritize source codes that affect the largest number of records.
Press ? to see all keyboard shortcuts — approve and reject are single keystrokes for fast triage.
Escalate a mapping when it needs a domain expert rather than a simple yes/no decision.
Approved mappings flow into the source-to-standard vocabulary used by every cohort and analysis — accuracy here propagates everywhere.
Confidence reflects the re-ranker's score; always confirm the standard concept's domain matches the source code's intent.
